title: Capstone Project: Synthetic Medical Data Generation
summary: A capstone project pipeline that generates and evaluates synthetic tabular medical data (Pima Indians Diabetes dataset) using CTGAN, TVAE, and TabDDPM, comparing them on TSTR utility, statistical fidelity, and privacy metrics. CTGAN and TVAE are run through SDV's single-table API (CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer) as two of the three generative models benchmarked.
evidence: generators/tvae_generator.py:12-68 and ctgan_generator.py:12-68 instantiate TVAESynthesizer/CTGANSynthesizer from sdv.single_table and call .fit()/train
